size.note: Newman's 70 cm. Wikipedia 62–72 cm. Wingspan: Wikipedia gives 155–180 cm. Mass: Wikipedia gives 1.5–2.6 kg.

habitat: Protected game areas, Okavango and Zambezi valley; woodland and savanna near water. Often at carcasses and camps (Newman's; SABAP1).

distribution.note: GBIF records per 10 000 bird records in each region: far north 9.4, north 23, central 45, south 30 (counted 13 November 2026). Recorded most often in the central region.

summary: A small slender-billed brown vulture with a bare pinkish face and a 'hood' of downy feathers. Much smaller than Lappet-faced or White-headed (Newman's).

similar.note: White-headed is larger with white head/underparts and a heavy red-and-blue bill (Newman's).
Lappet-faced is huge with crimson head and massive bill (Newman's).
